cards.title: Passing Port Royal
instructions: Stay 3 NM clear of KRAS when para-jumping is in effect
cards.source: Binder, p. 20; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slide 79.

cards.title: Abeam Mustang Beach: switch to UHF CH 17
cards.leadIn: Abeam Mustang Beach, expect ATC to switch you to CH 17. If ATC has not directed the switch by abeam Mustang Beach Airport, request it:

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Corpus Departure, <callsign>, abeam Mustang Beach, request switch CH 17.

exchange.speaker: Departure
exchange.text: <callsign>, Corpus Departure, contact approach / change to my frequency, CH 17.

cards.source: Binder, p. 20; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slide 79.

cards.title: Check in on Corpus Approach · UHF CH 17

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Corpus Approach, <callsign>, on CH 17 for Mustang {to.area.spoken}.

cards.title: Turn into {to.area}
instructions: Climb to your working altitude once established under the area
cards.source: Binder, p. 20; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slide 79.
